en.title: One week, 1,430 km² more white ground in Slovakia
en.description: One week, 1,430 km² more white ground in Slovakia. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Slovakia on 16 November.
en.lede: Seven days ago about 590 km² of high ground was white in Slovakia; today it is 2,020 km², a gain of 1,430 km².

p: The new white ground is mostly in the middle heights, where a single cold spell can turn grass into a usable base.
Snow covers roughly 2,020 km² in Slovakia on 16 November, 1,070 km² lost since yesterday. In other words, 11 % of the mapped high ground is white.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: Think 1,200 m and higher for a white landscape. Compared with 590 km² seven days ago, that is 1,430 km² more.
Hardly any new snow fell in the last three days: the three-day maximum is 1 cm.
The deepest snow of the country's resorts is at Ski centrum Dedinky: 48 cm.
Close behind: Ski Grúniky (40 cm), Vernár (34 cm), Kubínská hola (33 cm) and Ski Zábava Hruštín (33 cm).
Ski centrum Dedinky picked up 1 cm in the last three days and could add 0 cm by Thursday 19 November.
Ski Grúniky had no fresh snow in the last three days; 1 cm could fall by Thursday 19 November.
42 of the 107 resorts we follow in Slovakia have snow on their upper slopes.

The rest of the shortlist: Vernár: 34 cm on top, 1 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Kubínská hola: 33 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 3 cm expected; Ski Zábava Hruštín: 33 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 3 cm expected.
Snow is in the forecast: up to 8 cm by the end of the third day, up to 16 cm within seven days.
The snowiest day looks like Tuesday 17 November, with up to 4 cm in the snowiest spots.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 31 cm on the snowiest slopes.

Height makes the difference: 500-1,000 m: on average under 1 cm (5 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average 1 cm (40 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 7 cm (98 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 13 cm (100 % of the ground white).

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Poland: 11 % white, deepest Orlické Záhoří with 45 cm, up to 15 cm in the week ahead; Czechia: 3 % white, deepest Bílá with 31 cm, up to 8 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 1,500 m the ground is almost fully white (98 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 1,000 m and 1,500 m the cover is patchy, about 40 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,000 m the slopes are still almost bare.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: Mild weather is eating into the cover: expect firm snow in the morning and slush in the afternoon.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.

sk.title: Koľko snehu je na Slovensku? Snehová pokrývka a predpoveď, 16. novembra 2026
sk.description: Sneh na Slovensku 16. novembra: snehová pokrývka, nový sneh, výška podľa nadmorskej výšky, ďalšie dni a najlepšie strediská.
sk.lede: Na Slovensku je dnes pod snehom asi 2 020 km² (pondelok, 16. novembra). To je o 1 070 km² menej ako včera.

p: Snehová hranica je okolo 1 200 m. V porovnaní s 590 km² pred siedmimi dňami je to nárast o 1 430 km².
Posledné tri dni takmer nesnežilo: maximum je 1 cm.

Výška snehu závisí od nadmorskej výšky: 500–1 000 m: priemerne pod 1 cm (5 % pod snehom); 1 000–1 500 m: priemerne 1 cm (40 % pod snehom); 1 500–2 000 m: priemerne 7 cm (98 % pod snehom); 2 000–2 500 m: priemerne 13 cm (100 % pod snehom).
Odmäk zjedá pokrývku: ráno tvrdý sneh, poobede mokrý.
Počas najbližších troch dní sa čaká až 8 cm, za celý týždeň až 16 cm.
Najsnežnejší deň: utorok, 17. novembra, až 4 cm.
Ďalej, v dňoch 8–14, môže na najzasneženejších svahoch pribudnúť až 31 cm.
Najviac snehu na horných tratiach: Ski centrum Dedinky, 48 cm.
Ďalej: Ski Grúniky (40 cm), Vernár (34 cm), Kubínská hola (33 cm) a Ski Zábava Hruštín (33 cm).
Ski centrum Dedinky: 1 cm nového snehu za tri dni a do dátumu štvrtok, 19. novembra ešte až 0 cm.

advice: Nad hranicou lesa môže byť sneh nafúkaný vetrom: pozor na hrebeňoch.
Pred jazdou mimo zjazdoviek si prečítajte miestnu lavínovú predpoveď.
